title: Block & Hans Fine American Ale | Dining at EPCOT® | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Block & Hans Located in World Showcase at EPCOT Wet your whistle with a stop at this popular spot and let the “Purveyors of Fine American Ale” introduce you to some of the great American craft beers! Pretzel bites with cheese sauce and bottled water are also available.View Menu American Bars & Lounges Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Operating Hours – 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM Valid admission required.
